a chemical used on surfaces to destroy unwanted microorganisms
a biological material that poses a risk to health
the practices that keep cultures free of unwanted organisms
items.s: Autoclave: a sealed chamber that sterilises equipment with pressurised steam. The other options describe Aseptic technique, Disinfectant, Biohazard.

items.q: The correct meaning of Antibiotic is
o: a preparation of living microbes that improves nutrient supply to crops
a substance from a microorganism that inhibits other microorganisms
a preparation that stimulates protective immunity against a disease
a fuel produced from living matter or from biological waste
items.s: Antibiotic: a substance from a microorganism that inhibits other microorganisms. The other options describe Vaccine, Biofertiliser, Biofuel.

items.q: In this course, Gene expression refers to
o: the molecule that stores genetic information in the order of bases
the process by which the information in a gene is used
the complete set of genetic material present in an organism
a DNA region that controls where and when a gene is copied
items.s: Gene expression: the process by which the information in a gene is used. The other options describe Promoter, Deoxyribonucleic acid, Genome.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Eukaryotic cell.
o: a cell type whose true nucleus is enclosed by a nuclear membrane
a series of enzyme-controlled reactions that leads to a product
a specialised part of the cell that performs a particular function
the cellular structure that assembles proteins from amino acids
items.s: Eukaryotic cell: a cell type whose true nucleus is enclosed by a nuclear membrane. The other options describe Organelle, Ribosome, Metabolic pathway.

items.q: In this course, Bioprocess technology refers to
o: the branch that improves crops and farm animals through biological techniques

the use of biological methods to manufacture chemicals, fuels and materials
items.s: Bioprocess technology: the design of vessels and conditions that support living systems at scale. The other options describe Industrial biotechnology, Medical biotechnology, Agricultural biotechnology.

items.q: The correct meaning of Industrial biotechnology is

the use of biological methods to manufacture chemicals, fuels and materials
items.s: Industrial biotechnology: the use of biological methods to manufacture chemicals, fuels and materials. The other options describe Modern biotechnology, Medical biotechnology, Classical biotechnology.
